reviews.title: INCREDIBLE CHEAP FANS
reviews.comment: (These are the top and bottom fans pictured as well as on the cpu cooler, not the ones at the front or back of the case) wowza, these are an incredible value! As compared to fans triple the price for a single fan, they provide comparable performance and almost as good aesthetics. The white color is pretty good for my liking, not too blue or yellow. Other colors look great as well. Lighting is simple and good enough, some may not find them bright enough, but THEY’RE CHEAP, so who cares? The airflow is great. I also love the daisy chaining ability. Sure, it could be better, like the fancy, expensive snap together fans, but this design works fine, and being able to daisy chain both the fan speed and rgb was a welcome surprise. Other reviews that mention bad screw holes are right, these are tough to screw in. They don’t appear to be threaded from the factory at all. For the price though, nothing that would dissuade me from recommending them!

reviews.title: Great fans.
reviews.comment: I purchased these fans based on the positive reviews and price/value. I was disappointed to find out I could not connect them to my MOBO, as it does not have a 3-pin 5V ARGB header. It only has a 12V 4-pin RGB header. The fans themselves work fine and are very quiet, but they would have been only white without any color effect. To some extent, I blame myself for not carefully reading the full description, and I was planning to return them for a refund. Luckily, I purchased an adapter/controller, powered by SATA and it allows daisy chaining the 3-pin ARGB connectors. I tested them and all is good, with wonderful ARGB effect and ultra quiet spinning. I cancelled the return. I am very pleased with these budget ARGB fans. Highly recommend. Thank you.
